newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA corn export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Corn: Net sales of 242,800 MT fell 58 percent from the previous week and 72 percent from the 4-week average. Major increases reported for Japan (111,800 MT), Poland (73,700 MT), Algeria (72,500 MT), Syria (66,100 MT, including 14,500 in new sales and 51,600 in destination changes), Egypt (65,900 MT, includes 67,500 in destination changes and 1,600 in foreign purchases/cancellations), and South Korea (53,000 MT) were partially offset by decreases reported for unknown destinations (191,000 MT), Belgium (60,000 MT), Brazil (52,500 MT), and Taiwan (51,100 MT).

Exports of 1,299,500 MT were 6 percent above the prior week and 11 percent over the 4-week average. Japan (397,400 MT), Poland (119,700 MT), Egypt (115,900 MT), Malaysia (102,000 MT), Saudi Arabia (78,300 MT), Mexico (67,900 MT), and Taiwan (66,400 MT) were the principal recipients.
